use: Selected art-direction key frames; visual references for the implemented scenes, not technical diagrams.

key_frames.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a final standalone 1536 × 1024 landscape website key frame for CODEX — The Anatomy of a Book.
Input image: the supplied reference is the exact art-direction and layout reference. Produce the II — SHEET scene variation, preserving its warm ivory museum-publishing world, refined very large Cormorant Garamond-like serif typography, restraint, delicate header, spacious composition, natural photographic materials, and exquisite soft shadows.
Scene/backdrop: one continuous warm ivory #eee9dd field, not a card and not an inset photograph.
Primary subject: ONE monumental unprinted handmade ivory paper sheet occupying the right 60% of the composition. It is nearly flat and almost horizontal in perspective, with only a very gentle, physically plausible shallow S-shaped flex. A single small thickness is visible along its near edge. Beautiful subtle real cellulose fibre, pressed paper surface, delicate irregularity, natural contact shadow. Material must unmistakably read as a single thin sheet of paper, not cloth, not a stone slab, not foam and not a folded stack. No crease yet. The paper feels architectural through scale, while still thin and flexible. Keep paper clear of the text.
Composition: delicate site header at top: 'CODEX' top left, 'The anatomy of a book' top centre, 'Contents +' top right; use restrained dark sans type with generous tracking. Left 40% is calm editorial negative space. Oversized refined dark serif heading on the left, exactly two lines: 'Before the book,' / 'a sheet.' Below, smaller refined serif copy, exactly two lines: 'Flat, but never without depth.' / 'Light finds the fibres. A fold finds the grain.' Keep clear spacing between heading and copy. Tiny chapter marker at bottom left: 'II — SHEET'.
Lighting: soft warm studio daylight from upper left, nuanced material depth, gentle natural shadow, no hard spotlight and no glossy surface.
Avoid: cards, buttons, photographs inside rectangles, borders, thick rules, decorative panels, books, multiple sheets, fold stacks, marbling, hands, tools, busy UI, parchment, antique nostalgia, exaggerated curling, strong gold, mismatched typography, text errors, cropped text, large empty white rectangle.
The result should feel like one museum-publishing key visual with type and paper in a single world.
key_frames.inspection: Correct copy, fine fibre, one thin uncreased sheet, shallow physical flex, clear editorial negative space.

key_frames.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a final standalone 1536 × 1024 landscape website key frame for CODEX — The Anatomy of a Book.
Input image: use the supplied reference as the exact art-direction and layout reference. Create the VI — SPINE scene variation, preserving its warm ivory museum-publishing world, refined Cormorant Garamond-like typography, quiet precise mood, delicate header, spacious editorial layout, photoreal material textures and soft shadows.
Scene/backdrop: one continuous warm ivory #eee9dd field. No cards or inset photo.
Primary subject: on the right 60% of the scene, a monumental bound but uncovered book text block seen in a close three-quarter view from its gently convex spine. The viewer must clearly see the ordered row of slightly curved folded ivory signatures along that spine, accurately repeated and pressed tightly together into one body. Show three narrow woven linen sewing tapes crossing the spine horizontally at evenly spaced sewing stations, extending just a little at each side. Fine restrained linen thread really connects the signatures. A very thin cream lining strip is hovering immediately above the spine, its lower end beginning to settle onto the spine, giving a calm sense of the spine structure becoming one object. A neat modest hand-sewn headband at the head and another at the tail: tiny alternating cream and warm grey thread around a fine core. Paper edge grain and minute changes in stacked sheet edges are visible. Physically plausible, orderly, quiet. No cover boards at this stage.
Composition: match the supplied website scene. Header exactly: 'CODEX' at top left; 'The anatomy of a book' top centre; 'Contents +' top right. Delicate restrained dark sans lettering with generous tracking. Left 40% reserved for clear beautiful editorial typography. Left large refined dark serif heading in exactly two lines: 'The quiet' / 'backbone.' Beneath it, smaller copy in exactly two lines: 'A thousand edges.' / 'One continuous body.' Bottom left tiny chapter marker: 'VI — SPINE'. Keep the entire book text block and its lining visually separate from the words and leave breathing room below the header.
Lighting/materials: photoreal museum conservation product photography, soft warm studio light from upper left, natural contact shadows, shallow raised paper edge texture, dry finely woven linen tapes, pressed smooth cream lining, rich but restrained physical detail.
Avoid: cards, panels, busy UI, diagrams with many labels, cutaway illustrations, tools, needles, hands, leather covers, shelves, antique objects, excessive loose paper, chaotic thread, gold shine, strong orange, thick rope, fabric pretending to be paper, invented writing on the book. No text errors or cropped type.
The result is an exceptionally polished museum-publishing scene where an ordered group of folds becomes one continuous book body.
key_frames.inspection: Correct copy, aligned folded signatures, three linen tapes, restrained headbands and thin cream lining, clear typography.
